latestVersion.changelog:
Videomaker Freelance 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Instantly edit and deliver client-ready 1080p MP4 videos from raw footage by describing the edits you want, no timeline or export settings needed.
- Automatic onboarding with anonymous token generation; connects to a cloud GPU-powered editing API.
- Supports uploading, editing, credit tracking, export, and real-time status feedback for video projects.
- Accepts various video, image, and audio file types up to 500MB.
- All core workflows (quick edit, batch, iterative refinement) ready for immediate use.
